description: List Follow On Tours' golf trips — the Trump portfolio venues, with the courses played, the hotel, nights, rounds and maximum group size, and a link to each trip's page. Use this for any golf enquiry. No payment is taken online. Most are priced on request; a set-price week (such as Sri Lanka) carries `dates` and per-person `prices` in GBP, which are the prices on its public page and may be quoted exactly as given. Golf trips sold on request with no fixed dates (e.g. golf in Argentina) come back in `onRequestTrips`, with their full page text in `details`; use request_quote for them. A set-price week and its country's bespoke golf (e.g. Legends & Paradise Golf Premier and Golf in Sri Lanka) are two different trips: the week has set dates, a set price and a set programme; the bespoke trip is any dates, any length and any courses, quoted on request. Offer the one that fits and mention the other (`alsoBespoke` on the week, `alsoBookable` on the bespoke trip). Golf trips are separate from the cricket tours in list_tours.
name: list_golf_trips
title: Golf trips
